# 07 · Widget specification

Full config schema, JS API, events, postMessage contract, install snippets, preview behavior, a11y, perf and browser matrix. Pairs with ADR 006.

## 1 · Config schema (what owners edit, stored in `bots.draft_config`)


## 2 · JavaScript API

Exposed on `window.Knowmivo` by the loader.

```ts
type KnowmivoEvent =
  | { type: 'ready' }
  | { type: 'open' } | { type: 'close' }
  | { type: 'message'; role: 'user'|'assistant'; text: string; messageId: string }
  | { type: 'lead'; values: Record<string,string> }
  | { type: 'escalated'; conversationId: string; severity: string }
  | { type: 'error'; code: string; message: string };

interface Knowmivo {
  init(opts: {
    botId: string;
    api?: string;
    position?: 'bottom-right'|'bottom-left'|'top-right'|'top-left';
    theme?: Partial<Appearance>;
    language?: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  }): void;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  toggle(): void;
  sendMessage(text: string): Promise<{ messageId: string }>;
  identify(opts: { userId: string; email?: string; name?: string; attributes?: Record<string, unknown>; hmac?: string }): void;
  setMetadata(data: Record<string, unknown>): void;  // page/product/cart context
  setTheme(theme: Partial<Appearance>): void;
  on<T extends KnowmivoEvent['type']>(type: T, cb: (e: Extract<KnowmivoEvent, {type: T}>) => void): () => void;
  destroy(): void;
  readonly version: string;
}
```

**HMAC identity**: when `rules_identity.hmac_required=true`, every `identify()` call must include `hmac = HMAC_SHA256(bot_secret, userId + '|' + email + '|' + ts)`. Backend verifies and persists `visitor_sessions.identified_user_id`. Without the HMAC, the visitor stays anonymous.

**Custom launcher** via any element: `<button data-knowmivo-open>`. The loader attaches a delegated click handler.

## 3 · postMessage contract (loader ↔ iframe)

- `{type: 'kmv:ready', publicId}` — iframe → loader
- `{type: 'kmv:open'}` / `{type: 'kmv:close'}` — both ways
- `{type: 'kmv:resize', width, height}` — iframe → loader (auto-resize)
- `{type: 'kmv:event', event: KnowmivoEvent}` — iframe → loader, fans out to `Knowmivo.on()` subscribers
- `{type: 'kmv:init', theme, metadata, identity}` — loader → iframe, sent once after `kmv:ready`
- Unknown types rejected; all messages gated by `event.origin === widgetOrigin`.

## 4 · Install snippets

| Snippet | File / component |
| --- | --- |
| Script tag | `<script src="https://cdn.knowmivo.com/embed.v1.js" data-bot-id="{publicId}" data-api="https://app.knowmivo.com" async></script>` |
| React | `@knowmivo/react` ships `<KnowmivoChat botId="…" />` — lazy-loads the loader; publishes v1 on Day 7 |
| Next.js app router | `<Script src="…embed.v1.js" data-bot-id="…" strategy="lazyOnload" />` |
| GTM | Custom-HTML tag with the script-tag snippet; trigger on All Pages |
| WordPress | Plug-in `knowmivo-chat/` (free); or Code Snippets plug-in + the script tag |
| Shopify | Theme section `theme.liquid` → paste before `</body>` |
| Webflow / Wix / Squarespace | Instructions page with per-platform screenshots |
| iframe only | `<iframe src="https://app.knowmivo.com/widget/{publicId}" width="400" height="640" style="border:0">` |
| Hosted chat URL | `https://app.knowmivo.com/chat/{publicId}` |
| QR code | Owner UI generates PNG linking to hosted chat URL |

Each generator adds the exact owner `publicId` and provides a one-click Copy button. Verify-install check: owner UI polls `/widget/sessions/{publicId}` session counter; green when ≥1 session in the last 10 min.

## 5 · Preview-editor behavior

- Dashboard `/chatbot` already has sticky preview using the owner draft config.
- Add: live apply on every control change (debounced 150 ms); device toggle (desktop/mobile); theme preset swap (light/dark/auto); publish button creates an immutable `publications` snapshot that the widget fetches via `/widget/config/{publicId}`.

## 6 · Accessibility checklist (WCAG 2.1 AA)

- All buttons have labels (`aria-label` or visible text).
- Focus trap inside the iframe when open; `Escape` closes.
- Focus returns to the launcher after close.
- Keyboard: `Tab` reaches composer; `Enter` sends; `Shift+Enter` newline; `Esc` closes.
- Color contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for text — the color picker warns when outside AA.
- `prefers-reduced-motion`: disables launcher animation, Dot pulse, and fade transitions.
- ARIA-live region on the assistant bubble announces new tokens as they stream (polite).
- Screen-reader order: header → transcript → composer (not reversed by position prop).

## 7 · Performance budget

- Loader (`embed.v1.js`) ≤ 10 KB gzipped (current measured: 4.2 KB — within budget).
- Iframe first paint ≤ 500 ms on 4G (Fast 3G throttled).
- Loader async, non-blocking, 0 CLS on host page.
- No global CSS on host.

## 8 · Browser matrix (launch)

- Chrome, Edge, Firefox ≥ last 2 versions.
- Safari ≥ 16 (desktop + iOS).
- Opera, Samsung Internet — best-effort.
- Playwright matrix in CI: Chromium + WebKit + Firefox.

## 9 · Security

- Domain allow-list enforced server-side on `/widget/config/...` and `/widget/sessions/...`.
- HMAC-signed identity for identified visitors.
- `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms"` on iframe, never `allow-same-origin`.
- CSP `frame-ancestors *` on `/widget/*` only; strict elsewhere.
- Per-visitor + per-IP rate limits on bootstrap; per-session rate limit on messages.
- `postMessage` origin check + schema validation.
